<!-- Release: v0.15.1 -->

Development APK for Android 8 or newer. Signed with the project development key; uses a separate `.debug` application ID. Production distribution signing is not configured.

## Changes

- Consistent Queue flicks and gesture ownership; reversing a drawer peek keeps the player open
- Lower, balanced player controls, a translucent seek bar and top handle, and smoother artwork/lyrics fades
- Softer return buttons and current-queue styling, animated selection panels and drag landings, and a frosted cancel target
- Working collection links from Queue information and visible Library loading progress

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/77 - Player gestures, selection transitions, layout and queue navigation

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.15.1-debug.apk` from **Assets** below (Android 8+).
2. Open the APK and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted. Install over the existing development build to retain your data.
3. First use: open **More → Scan music**, choose **Folders to scan**, then **Scan now**.
